pages.label: Home
pages.title: Century Expeditions | Tanzania Safari Experts
pages.content: Century Expeditions creates Tanzania safari, wildlife, culture, mountain and island experiences with local specialists and professional guides.

pages.label: Safari tours
pages.title: Tours & Safaris | Century Adventures Tanzania
pages.content: Private safari journeys across Tanzania include wildlife, safari and beach, Northern Tanzania and Great Migration experiences. The page also describes flexible and custom itineraries and Custom 4x4 options. Published listings include duration and starting rates; final itinerary, inclusions and availability are confirmed in writing.

pages.label: Safari packages and itineraries
pages.title: Safari Packages & Itineraries | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Compare published safari packages, explore trip information and request a tailored proposal. Select a listed package or choose Custom Journey to share destinations and duration. The current listings supply starting prices but do not specify their full inclusion basis; request a written quotation confirming accommodation, meals, activities, transport, fees, exclusions and price conditions. Rates are indicative per person and final prices depend on dates, group size, accommodation and availability.

pages.label: Tanzania destinations
pages.title: Tanzania Destinations | Century Adventures Tanzania
pages.content: Explore Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Nyerere, Ruaha, Mikumi, Katavi, Gombe, Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar.

pages.label: Serengeti National Park
pages.title: Serengeti National Park | Century Expeditions
pages.content: The Serengeti offers 14,763 square kilometres of open plains, extraordinary wildlife, the Great Migration and regions such as Seronera and the Mara River area. Lions, leopards, cheetahs and elephants bring the landscape to life.

pages.label: Ngorongoro Conservation Area
pages.title: Ngorongoro Conservation Area | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Ngorongoro connects the Serengeti plains with the Great Rift Valley. The volcanic crater, wildlife, Maasai communities, Olduvai Gorge and highland scenery can be combined with a Serengeti safari.

pages.label: Tarangire National Park
pages.title: Tarangire National Park | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Tarangire is known for ancient baobabs, golden grasslands, the Tarangire River and large elephant herds. It is often paired with Ngorongoro and Serengeti in a northern Tanzania itinerary.

pages.label: Lake Manyara National Park
pages.title: Lake Manyara National Park | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Lake Manyara combines groundwater forest, open grassland and lakeside scenery beneath the Rift Valley escarpment, with wildlife, birdwatching and changing seasonal landscapes.

pages.label: Nyerere National Park
pages.title: Nyerere National Park (Selous) | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Nyerere National Park protects part of the wider Selous landscape and is shaped by the Rufiji River, rivers, woodlands and open plains. Game drives and river experiences are available where appropriate.

pages.label: Ruaha National Park
pages.title: Ruaha National Park | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Ruaha is a quieter southern wilderness of rolling hills, ancient baobabs, open woodland and the Great Ruaha River, with varied habitats and memorable wildlife encounters.

pages.label: Mikumi National Park
pages.title: Mikumi National Park | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Mikumi offers open grasslands, woodland, scenic horizons and southern Tanzania game drives, with opportunities to discover iconic wildlife and the smaller details of the bush.

pages.label: Katavi National Park
pages.title: Katavi National Park | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Katavi is remote western Tanzania with seasonal floodplains, woodland, waterways and unhurried wildlife exploration far from busy safari routes.

pages.label: Gombe Stream National Park
pages.title: Gombe Stream National Park | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Gombe is a forest sanctuary beside Lake Tanganyika, with guided forest walks, chimpanzee encounters, forest trails and lakeside beauty.

pages.label: Family trips
pages.title: Family Adventures | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Family journeys are shaped around ages, interests and pace, with family-friendly stays, flexible safari days, age-appropriate activities, comfortable travel, dietary needs and accessibility needs.

pages.label: Honeymoon trips
pages.title: Honeymoon | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Honeymoons can combine private safari experiences, Zanzibar escapes or a safari-and-beach journey, shaped around interests, comfortable stays, balanced travel pace and special celebrations.

pages.label: Great Migration trips
pages.title: Great Migration Safari | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Migration planning follows seasonal movement of the herds. Calving is typically January-March and river-crossing possibilities are typically July-October. Rainfall changes movements, and crossings and sightings cannot be guaranteed.

pages.label: Volunteer programmes
pages.title: Volunteer | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Volunteer opportunities are locally guided and matched to project priorities, skills, interests and availability. The team explains project fees, accommodation, meals, transfers and screening before placement is confirmed.

pages.label: Kilimanjaro experiences
pages.title: Mount Kilimanjaro | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Kilimanjaro is a guided trek through changing landscapes from forest to alpine terrain, with expert support, preparation, patience and respect for conditions.

pages.label: Zanzibar holidays
pages.title: Zanzibar | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Zanzibar combines white-sand beaches, Stone Town, spice gardens, island culture and relaxed beach stays. The island can be added to a mainland safari.

pages.label: Photo gallery
pages.title: Photo Gallery | Century Expeditions
pages.content: The photo gallery shows Century Expeditions wildlife, landscapes, safari and Tanzania travel experiences.

pages.label: Safari vehicles
pages.title: Safari 4x4 Vehicles | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Purpose-built safari 4x4s support wildlife viewing and comfortable travel. Vehicle suitability, pop-up roof options, seating and luggage space are discussed around the route and group size.

pages.label: Tanzania travel guide
pages.title: Tanzania Travel Guide | Century Expeditions
pages.content: The guide covers arrival and documents, money, packing, culture and getting around. Confirm nationality-specific and date-specific requirements before travel.

pages.label: Health and safety
pages.title: Health & Safety | Century Expeditions
pages.content: Published guidance recommends speaking with a qualified travel-health professional, arranging insurance for treatment, evacuation and planned activities, and preparing medicines, documents and emergency contacts. Individual medical advice comes from a qualified clinician.

pages.label: Booking and payment
pages.title: Booking & Payment Information | Century Expeditions
pages.content: The booking process is enquiry, itinerary and quotation, agreement of details, payment using official invoice instructions, then written confirmation. Sending an enquiry does not confirm a booking. Review booking terms, payment instructions, changes and cancellations on the published page.

pages.label: Contact Century Expeditions
pages.title: Contact Us | Century Expeditions Tanzania
pages.content: The team can help with safari bookings, Kilimanjaro climbing, group and private tours, volunteer placements, airport transfers, family vacations, accommodation, honeymoon packages, Zanzibar holidays and corporate or education tours. Phone and WhatsApp: +255 747 115 390. Email: visit@century-adventures.com. Bookings: bookings@century-adventures.com.

pages.label: About Century Expeditions
pages.title: About Us | Century Expeditions Tanzania
pages.content: Century Expeditions is a Tanzanian travel company creating personal journeys through wildlife, culture, mountains and island shores, with local specialists, professional guides, responsible travel and tailor-made journeys.
